description: The run command that makes the container's own filesystem immutable and hands back scratch space with tmpfs mounts.

steps.description: Run interactively, remove on exit, and add `--read-only`. The page says this makes the entire container root filesystem immutable.
Two `--tmpfs` mounts give back the scratch space tools need: `/tmp` and the agent's `.cache` directory, both in memory and discarded on exit.

Mount the project at `/work` read-write and the notes vault at `/reference` read-only. The page says an agent under this configuration cannot install a background service, cannot modify its own tooling, and cannot leave anything behind outside `/work`.

title: Read-Only Root
